UTC は時刻の基準。+09:00 は UTC より 9 時間進んだ表記です。比: UTC is a time standard. +09:00 means nine hours ahead of UTC. Convert timestamps to the same basis before comparing them.
出来事の発生時刻と、収集側が記録を受け取った時刻。通信の遅れなどで一致しない場合: The time an event occurred and the time the collector received its record. Network delays and other factors can make them different.
event_time=10:00Z、ingest_time=10:03Z は発生: event_time=10:00Z and ingest_time=10:03Z mean the record arrived three minutes after the event.
この教材では起動を区別する追跡用 ID と、その親の ID。端末名と起動区間も合: In this course, these are a process instance's tracking ID and its parent's ID. Also match the host and the period in which the process ran.
P-2 の parent_process_guid=P-1 なら同じ端末の P-: If P-2 has parent_process_guid=P-1, its parent is P-1 on the same host.
要求を受けてアプリへ中継するサーバー。アプリの接続元と利用者側の接続の IP が: A server that receives requests and forwards them to an application. The source IP seen by the application may differ from the client connection's IP.
アプリの src=10.30.0.8 が中継サーバーを指す場合がある。: The application's src=10.30.0.8 may refer to an intermediary server.
機器の時刻と実際の時刻のずれ。誤差範囲が重なると時刻だけで前後を断定できません。: The difference between a device's clock and the actual time. If the possible time ranges overlap, timestamps alone cannot establish the order.
10:00:20±30 秒なら 09:59:50〜10:00:50 の可能性。: 10:00:20 ±30 seconds could mean any time from 09:59:50 to 10:00:50.
どの対象・種類・時刻の記録を取得できているか。未収集から未発生とは言えません。: The targets, record types, and time periods covered by the available logs. An event cannot be ruled out merely because its logs were not collected.
設定変更は収集済みでもダウンロード記録は無効の場合がある。: Configuration changes may be logged even when download logging is disabled.
影響の広がりを抑える対処。権限・承認と業務影響を確かめ、対象と効果を記録します。: Action to limit the spread of impact. Check authority, approval, and business impact, then record the target and observed effect.
問題の共有リンクだけを無効にして状態を再確認する。: Disable only the affected sharing link, then check its state again.
鍵は認証に使う情報、セッションは認証後の利用単位。この教材のサービスでは鍵と既存: A credential is used to authenticate; a session represents access after authentication. In this course's service, disabling a credential and ending an existing session are separate actions.
K-42 の新規認証を止めても S-440 は別途無効化する。: Stopping new authentication with K-42 does not invalidate S-440; that requires a separate action.
秘密の値を通常報告で見えなくすること。原本の保管や参照は組織の手順に従います。: Hiding secret values in routine reports. Follow your organization's procedures for storing and referring to originals.
credential_value=[REDACTED] とし credentia: Use credential_value=[REDACTED] and track the credential by credential_id.
この教材では、リンクを知る人がログインなしで対象を閲覧できる共有設定。資料の内容: In this course, a sharing setting that lets anyone with the link view the target without signing in. It does not mean the document's contents have been anonymized.
access=anonymous のリンクには、誰が閲覧できるかの確認が必要。: For a link with access=anonymous, check who can view the target.
日付をまたぐ時差を直す: Convert a timestamp across a date boundary
UTC と日本時間を同じ基準にそろえる: Put UTC and Japan time on the same basis
時刻の書き方が違うと、同じ出来事が別の日に見えることがあります。まず 1 行だけ: Different time formats can make the same event appear to occur on different dates. Start by converting one record to UTC.
Z は UTC、+09:00 は UTC より 9 時間進んだ時刻です。日本時間: Z indicates UTC. +09:00 indicates a time nine hours ahead of UTC. Japan time also uses +09:00.
+09:00 の日時から 9 時間引くと UTC になります。午前 9 時より前: Subtract nine hours from a +09:00 timestamp to obtain UTC. If the local time is before 09:00, the UTC date is the previous day.
時差を直すことと機器の時計のずれを補正することは別です。この問題の時計にはずれが: Converting a time zone and correcting a device's clock error are different tasks. Assume the clock in this question is accurate.
2026-10-18T02:40:00+09:00 は、9 時間引くと 2026: Subtracting nine hours from 2026-10-18T02:40:00+09:00 gives 2026-10-17T17:40:00Z. The date also moves back one day.
この記録の時刻を UTC に直し、日付も含めて入力してください。形式は YYYY: Convert this record's timestamp to UTC and enter both the date and time. Use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS UTC.
00:08:30 から 9 時間引くと、前日の 15:08:30 UTC です。: Subtracting nine hours from 00:08:30 gives 15:08:30 UTC on the previous day. The correct timestamp is 2026-10-21T15:08:30Z.
末尾の +09:00 を確認します。UTC に直すときは 9 時間引きます。: Check the +09:00 suffix. Subtract nine hours to convert to UTC.
UTC に直した時刻が前日に入る場合は、日付も戻します。日付と時刻を一組で計算し: If the UTC time falls on the previous day, move the date back too. Calculate the date and time together.
10 月 21 日の 15:08:30 UTC を、日付つきで入力します。: Enter October 21 at 15:08:30 UTC, including the full date.
2026-10-21T15:08:30Z と入力します。時刻だけでなく前日になっ: Enter 2026-10-21T15:08:30Z. Adjust both the time and the date, which moves to the previous day.
別のログを並べる前に、時刻の基準をそろえて記録します。: Normalize and record the time basis before combining different logs.
発生時刻と到着時刻を分ける: Separate event time from arrival time
出来事の順序に使う時刻の欄を選ぶ: Choose the timestamp field for ordering events
ログが集まるまでに数分かかることがあります。画面にある二つの時刻を同じ意味で読ま: Logs may take several minutes to arrive. Practice distinguishing the meanings of the two timestamps on screen.
ここでは Elastic Common Schema（ECS）という共通の項目定: These synthetic JSON records use Elastic Common Schema (ECS) field definitions. JSON represents data as "field": "value" pairs and groups fields inside braces.
このログの @timestamp は記録元の発生時刻、event の内側にある: In this log, @timestamp is the event time at the source. The ingested field inside event (event.ingested) is the time the record arrived at central storage. They correspond to event_time and ingest_time in this course.
転送待ちがあると到着は遅くなります。到着の順序だけでは出来事の順序を決められませ: Forwarding queues can delay arrival. Arrival order alone cannot establish event order. In this exercise, clocks are synchronized and @timestamp contains the original event time.
{\"@timestamp\": \"2026-10-18T07:02:00Z\: {"@timestamp": "2026-10-18T07:02:00Z", "event": {"ingested": "2026-10-18T07:06:00Z"}} records an event at 07:02 that reached central storage four minutes later.
出来事が起きた時刻を時系列に記載します。使う欄を 1 つ選んでください。: You are adding the time the event occurred to a timeline. Select the one field to use.
ECS のフィールドに合わせた合成 JSON ログ: Synthetic JSON logs using ECS field definitions
発生時刻は @timestamp の 11:14:20 UTC です。event: The event time is 11:14:20 UTC in @timestamp. The event.ingested value of 11:19:05 is the arrival time at central storage, not the time of the operation.
出来事そのものと、記録が中央の保存先に届くことを分けます。: Distinguish the event itself from the arrival of its record at central storage.
JSON の二つの日付と、学習欄にある項目名の対応を照合します。: Match the two JSON timestamps to the field definitions in the learning notes.
@timestamp の欄を選びます。発生時刻を時系列に使い、event.ing: Select @timestamp. Use the event time in the timeline and treat the difference from event.ingested as collection delay.
発生と収集の時刻を混同せず、記録を並べます。: Order records without confusing event time with collection time.
この記録では記録元で出来事が発生した時刻。: The time the event occurred at the source in this record.
event 内の ingested。中央の保存先へ到着した時刻。: The ingested field inside event: the time the record reached central storage.
event 内の action。グループへのメンバー追加。: The action field inside event: adding a member to a group.
user 内の id。操作で使われたアカウントの識別子。: The id field inside user: the identifier of the account used for the operation.
一時的な番号と追跡用 ID を区別する: Distinguish temporary numbers from tracking IDs
同じ名前のプログラムも何度も起動します。「どの起動から生まれたか」を読む練習です: A program with the same name can start many times. Practice identifying which process instance started another.
プロセスは実行中のプログラム一つひとつです。parent は、そのプロセスを起動: A process is an individual running instance of a program. Its parent is the process that started it.
pid は短い番号で、終了後に再利用されることがあります。この教材の proce: A pid is a short number that may be reused after a process exits. In this course, process_guid is a tracking ID that distinguishes process instances on the same host.
parent_process_guid は親の process_guid を示し: parent_process_guid identifies the parent's process_guid. Also check the host and the period in which the process ran.
host=pc-demo process_guid=P-9 parent_pro: With host=pc-demo process_guid=P-9 parent_process_guid=P-4, the parent of P-9 is P-4 on the same host. Do not link old records using only a short number such as pid=80.
この子プロセスを起動した「親の追跡用 ID」が入っている欄を選んでください。: Select the field containing the tracking ID of the parent that started this child process.
parent_process_guid=P-819 が親の追跡用 ID です。P: parent_process_guid=P-819 is the parent's tracking ID. P-820 identifies the child itself; parent_pid=260 is a short number that may be reused.
parent が付いている欄は、子ではなく親を表します。: A field containing parent refers to the parent, not the child.
親の番号と、親の起動を区別する追跡用 ID の二つがあります。学習欄の説明と照合: There is both a parent process number and a tracking ID for the parent's particular instance. Compare them with the learning notes.
parent_process_guid=P-819 を選びます。次の調査では同じ: Select parent_process_guid=P-819. The next investigation step is to find process_guid=P-819 on the same host.
親と子の ID を読み分け、プログラムのつながりを調べます。: Distinguish parent and child IDs to investigate relationships between programs.
子プロセス自身の追跡用 ID。: The child process's own tracking ID.
子プロセスの短い番号。: The child process's short process number.
親プロセスの短い番号。: The parent process's short process number.
表示名より ID を照合する: Match IDs rather than display names
同名アカウントを識別子で分ける: Use identifiers to distinguish accounts with the same name
表示名が同じでも、別のアカウントのことがあります。名前だけで操作した対象を決めな: Identical display names can refer to different accounts. Practice identifying the account used without relying on its name alone.
display_name は画面上の名前で、重複や変更があり得ます。actor_: display_name is the name shown on screen and may be duplicated or changed. actor_id identifies the account used for an operation.
この教材では台帳とログの actor_id が一致すれば同じアカウントを指します: In this course, matching actor_id values in the inventory and log identify the same account. The ID alone does not establish who actually used it.
表示名「連携処理」が同じでも、svc-150 と svc-151 は別のアカウン: Even if both have the display name 'Integration job', svc-150 and svc-151 are separate accounts. If the log identifies svc-151, consult the inventory entry for svc-151.
今回の操作で使われたアカウントとして、台帳と照合して確実に言える説明を選んでくだ: Match the log against the inventory and select the statement supported about the account used for this operation.
svc-621：表示名「定期連携」。勤怠システム連携用。\nsvc-622：表示:
svc-621: Display name 'ScheduledIntegration'. Used for attendance-system integration.
svc-622: Display name 'ScheduledIntegration'. Used for research-data aggregation.
Both are automation accounts, not people's names.
svc-622 は研究データ集計用アカウントです。表示名だけでは勤怠連携と区別で: svc-622 is the research-data aggregation account. The display name alone cannot distinguish it from attendance-system integration. Who performed the operation and whether it was authorized require separate checks.
二つの表示名は同じです。: The two display names are identical.
ログの actor_id と一致する台帳の ID を探し、その用途を読みます。: Find the inventory ID that matches actor_id in the log, then read its purpose.
研究データ集計用アカウントの利用までは分かりますが、人までは分かりません。: You can identify use of the research-data aggregation account, but not the person who used it.
「研究データ集計用の svc-622 が使われた。実行した人や正当性は未確認」を: Select 'The research-data aggregation account svc-622 was used. The operator and authorization remain unverified.'
表示名だけに頼らず、台帳の ID と突き合わせて対象を絞ります。: Narrow down the target by matching inventory IDs instead of relying only on display names.
勤怠連携の処理用の svc-621 が使われた。実行した人や正当性は未確認: The attendance-integration account svc-621 was used. The operator and authorization remain unverified.
ログの actor_id は svc-622 です。同じ表示名の svc-621: actor_id in the log is svc-622. This confuses it with svc-621, which has the same display name.
研究データ集計用の svc-622 が使われた。実行した人や正当性は未確認: The research-data aggregation account svc-622 was used. The operator and authorization remain unverified.
ID と用途が台帳に一致します。アカウントと実行した人の確認を分けています。: The ID and purpose match the inventory. This distinguishes identifying the account from identifying the person who used it.
勤怠システム連携用の svc-622 が使われた。実行した人や正当性は未確認: The attendance-system integration account svc-622 was used. The operator and authorization remain unverified.
ID は一致しますが、svc-622 の用途は研究データ集計です。表示名では用途: The ID matches, but svc-622 is used for research-data aggregation. Its display name does not establish its purpose.
同じ追跡 ID の再試行を分ける: Separate retries that share a tracking ID
要求 ID と試行番号を合わせて最後の経路を集める: Combine request ID and attempt number to collect the final path
同じ要求が自動でやり直されると、追跡 ID が同じ記録も増えます。検索で集めたあ: Automatic retries produce more records with the same tracking ID. Search for candidate records, then use the attempt number to select the relevant path.
trace_id は要求を追う ID、attempt は何回目の試行かを表す番号: trace_id tracks a request; attempt indicates which attempt it is. In this course, retries keep the same trace_id and increment attempt.
1 回目のアプリ応答が一時的なエラーだったため、同じ要求がもう一度実行されました: The first application response was a temporary error, so the request ran again. The final attempt here is attempt=2.
要求 ID や試行番号を検索語にして候補を絞り、その後で両方の条件を照合します。: Search using a request ID or attempt number, then check both conditions. The same trace_id can include different attempts, and the same attempt number can belong to different requests.
status=503 はサービスが処理を受け付けられなかった応答、200 は成功: status=503 means the service could not handle the request; 200 indicates a successful response. Neither alone establishes compromise or authorization.
TR-100 の attempt=1 が 503、attempt=2 が 200: If TR-100 has status 503 for attempt=1 and 200 for attempt=2, follow the final attempt by collecting each system's records with both TR-100 and attempt=2. Exclude attempt=2 of another request, TR-101.
TR-602 の最後の試行 attempt=2 に属する proxy・ident: Collect the three proxy, identity, and app records for the final attempt (attempt=2) of TR-602. Choose a search term that hides at least one irrelevant row while keeping all three required rows visible, then select only those three. Search uses substring matching. Example: trace_id=TR-602.
検索結果には TR-602 の 1 回目と 2 回目の計 6 行が含まれます。今: Searching for TR-602 returns six records across its first and second attempts. Select the three proxy, identity, and app records for attempt=2. Exclude attempt=1 of TR-602 and attempt=2 of the separate request TR-603.
必要な 3 行に共通して含まれる文字列を探します。検索は文字列の部分一致です。: Find a string shared by all three required rows. Search uses substring matching.
要求 ID または試行番号で絞れます。残った行で、もう一方の条件と system: Filter by request ID or attempt number. Then check the other condition and system in the remaining rows.
trace_id=TR-602 で検索し、その中の attempt=2 の pr: Search for trace_id=TR-602, then select the three proxy, identity, and app records with attempt=2.
trace_id=TR-602 で検索し、attempt=2 の付いた prox: Search for trace_id=TR-602 and select the proxy, identity, and app rows marked attempt=2. Distinguish retries of the same request when collecting its path.
ID で絞った検索結果に対し、試行番号や処理区間を追加で照合し、別の試行を混ぜず: After filtering by ID, also match the attempt number and processing period so that the evidence does not mix separate attempts.
親 ID と端末名を両方合わせる: Match both parent ID and host
複数条件で直接の子プロセスを選ぶ: Use multiple conditions to select direct child processes
ID が似ていても、別の端末の記録かもしれません。端末と親の ID を両方確認し: Similar IDs may belong to different hosts. Check both the host and the parent ID.
条件は host=lab-pc-07 と parent_process_guid: The two conditions are host=lab-pc-07 and parent_process_guid=P-701. Select only rows matching both.
直接の子は parent_process_guid が調べる親の ID に一致し: A direct child's parent_process_guid matches the parent's ID. Do not include children of those children.
表示された記録は同じ起動区間です。名前から善悪を判定する課題ではありません。: The displayed records belong to the same process execution period. This exercise does not ask you to judge a program's intent from its name.
pc-demo の親 P-10 の直接の子なら、別の端末の P-10 や、親が: For direct children of P-10 on pc-demo, exclude P-10 on another host and records whose parent is P-11.
host が lab-pc-07 で、parent_process_guid が: Select every record with host=lab-pc-07 and parent_process_guid=P-701. Include direct children only.
lab-pc-07 の P-702 と P-704 が P-701 の直接の子で: P-702 and P-704 on lab-pc-07 are direct children of P-701. P-703 is a child of P-702, so exclude it. lab-pc-08 is a different host.
まず host が lab-pc-07 ではない行を外します。: First exclude rows whose host is not lab-pc-07.
残った行の parent_process_guid を確認します。: Check parent_process_guid in the remaining rows.
P-702 と P-704 の 2 行だけが二つの条件を両方満たします。: Only the two rows for P-702 and P-704 match both conditions.
P-702 と P-704 の行を選びます。host と親 ID の両方を照合し: Select the P-702 and P-704 rows, matching both host and parent ID.
端末と ID を組み合わせ、別の出来事を混ぜないようにします。: Combine host and ID to avoid mixing unrelated events.
同じ資料への操作が繰り返されると、ログの行数は資料数より多くなります。対象の広が: Repeated operations on the same document produce more log rows than documents. Count the distinct targets involved.
object_id は資料を区別する ID です。同じ object_id が繰: object_id identifies a document. Repeated occurrences of the same object_id still represent one target document.
今回は share_created かつ result=success になった: Count distinct object_id values where the event is share_created and result=success. Exclude failures and read operations.
F-10 の成功が 2 行、F-11 の成功が 1 行なら、成功ログは 3 行で: Two successful rows for F-10 and one for F-11 make three success records but only two target documents.
共有作成（share_created）が成功した「異なる object_id」は: How many distinct object_id values have a successful share_created operation? Enter a number only.
条件に合う対象は DOC-201・DOC-202・DOC-204 の 3 件です: The matching targets are DOC-201, DOC-202, and DOC-204: three documents. There are four successful sharing records, but DOC-201 is counted once.
share_created かつ success の行だけに絞ります。: Keep only rows with share_created and success.
同じ object_id が何度出ても、対象としては 1 件にまとめます。: Count each object_id only once, however often it appears.
DOC-201、DOC-202、DOC-204 の三つを数えます。: Count the three IDs: DOC-201, DOC-202, and DOC-204.
3 と入力します。操作ログの行数と対象の種類数を分けて報告します。: Enter 3. Report log-row counts separately from distinct-target counts.
影響範囲を書くときに、何を数えた件数なのかを明確にします。: When reporting the scope of impact, make clear what your count measures.
時間範囲の端を確かめる: Check the boundaries of a time window
時差をそろえ、開始以上・終了未満で選ぶ: Normalize time zones and include the start but exclude the end
調査区間の端は読み違いが起こりやすい部分です。時差と範囲の二つを確認します。: Time-window boundaries are easy to misread. Check both the time zone and the interval.
対象は 2026-10-22 の 10:00:00 UTC 以上、10:10:0: The window is October 22, 2026, from 10:00:00 UTC inclusive to 10:10:00 UTC exclusive. Include the start, but exclude a record exactly at the end.
+09:00 は 9 時間引いて UTC に直します。操作は share_cre: Subtract nine hours from +09:00 timestamps to obtain UTC. Only share_created operations are in scope.
範囲を明記すると、担当交代時に同じ条件で再確認できます。: Documenting the interval lets the next analyst reproduce the same search conditions.
09:00 以上・09:05 未満なら、09:00:00 は対象、09:05:0: For 09:00 inclusive to 09:05 exclusive, 09:00:00 is included and 09:05:00 is excluded. 18:03+09:00 equals 09:03Z, so it is included.
2026-10-22 の 10:00:00 UTC 以上、10:10:00 UT: Select all share_created rows from 10:00:00 UTC inclusive to 10:10:00 UTC exclusive on October 22, 2026.
10:00:00Z、19:04:00+09:00（10:04:00Z）、10:0: Include 10:00:00Z, 19:04:00+09:00 (10:04:00Z), and 10:09:59Z. Exclude 19:10:00+09:00 because it is exactly the end, and exclude share_deleted because it is a different operation.
+09:00 の行は 9 時間引いて考えます。: Subtract nine hours from rows with +09:00.
F-402、F-403、F-404 の共有作成が対象です。: The share-creation records for F-402, F-403, and F-404 are in scope.
